stem: 一家银行的客户尽职调查团队经理发现,上个季度有一名高风险客户的活动未按银行内部规定的时间表进行审查.KYC团队经理应该做什么？

options.A: 提交转介以提交可疑活动报告(SAR)
options.B: 评估客户身份识别(KYC)审查流程以了解为何审查未按要求进行,并在必要时采取纠正措施

options.D: 将客户从银行的高风险名单中移除

dropped_by_test.knowledge_zh: 高风险客户需强化尽职调查（EDD），低风险客户可适用简化尽职调查（SDD）
dropped_by_test.knowledge_en: EDD for higher-risk, SDD for lower-risk customers
dropped_by_test.en_quote: Higher-risk customers might require EDD, while lower-risk customers might qualify for simplified due diligence (SDD) in some jurisdictions.
heading_context: Customer risk assessment versus enterprise-wide risk assessment

dropped_by_test.knowledge_zh: 高风险客户审查委员会评估政治敏感人物、代理行及其他高风险客户的准入和持续尽职调查，通常由业务负责人领导，金融犯罪防控合规团队构成法定人数。
dropped_by_test.knowledge_en: High-risk customer review committee definition and composition
dropped_by_test.en_quote: High-risk customer review committee: This committee assesses onboarding and ongoing due diligence for PEPs, correspondent banks, and other high-risk clients. It is typically led by business leaders, with AFC compliance teams forming part of the quorum.

dropped_by_test.knowledge_zh: 对于了解你的客户，她寻求增强的数字身份验证技术，并采用持续了解你的客户模型实现持续客户风险分析。
dropped_by_test.knowledge_en: KYC technology enhancements
dropped_by_test.en_quote: For KYC, she seeks enhanced digital identity verification technology and aims to use perpetual KYC models to move from periodic KYC reviews to continuous customer risk analysis.
heading_context: Case example: Implementing technology in AFC compliance
